name: MVTec Anomaly Detection (MVTec AD)
description: A real-world industrial anomaly-detection benchmark with over 5,000 high-resolution images across 15 object and texture categories. Training images are defect-free; test images include defective and defect-free examples, with pixel-precise anomaly annotations. VisA is a separate companion dataset for industrial anomaly detection. Dataset images are not vendored.
citation: Bergmann, P., Fauser, M., Sattlegger, D., and Steger, C. “MVTec AD—A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection.” CVPR 2019.

license.notes: MVTec states the dataset is released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; commercial use is not allowed.
